# Vendored browser assets

These files are stored locally so the dashboard works without a CDN connection.

| File | Package/source | Version |
|---|---|---:|
| `d3.min.js` | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/d3> | 7.9.0 |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/topojson-client> | 3.1.0 |
| `countries-110m.json` | <https://www.npmjs.com/package/world-atlas> | 2.0.2 |

The project uses only the minified browser distributions and the 110m country topology. Review the upstream package pages when updating versions.
